verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs that the Sentry team builds and maintains for most popular languages and frameworks, including Android, Apple (sentry-cocoa), Elixir, Dart and .NET, plus an SDK API for custom event reporting. A one-command agent plugin teaches coding agents to install and configure the SDK, and a community user reports deep integration helped by the SDKs being open source. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specific to the SDKs, and evidence of official client libraries for the management/web API (only an OpenAPI schema is shown).
